name: Navy Federal Credit Union
notes: Researched from public navyfederal.org pages only (no sign-in). The bill is a Navy Federal loan payment. Members pay loans by transfer in digital banking (Move Money / Transfers), from a Navy Federal account or an external account at another institution; recurring transfers are chosen with a frequency dropdown when scheduling. No public page documents paying a loan with a debit card from another bank, so online methods are bank transfers only (inferred). Sign-in is username + password on one screen (the Access Number is no longer used to sign in), followed by 2-Step Verification by text, email or push to a remembered device (push is not modelled). Up to 36 months of statements are kept online. Credit-card due dates can be moved to any day 1-28 once every 6 months. No guest/no-login loan payment page was found, so guest pay is left to the family default. Account closure is by branch, secure message, mail or phone (not modelled: the loan has no 'stop service').

autopay.note: Automatic loan payments are recurring transfers: pick a frequency when you schedule the transfer.

guest_pay.note: Navy Federal loans are paid after signing in to digital banking (Transfers / Move Money); there is no pay-without-signing-in page. Member Services can help with a payment around the clock at 1-888-842-6328.

payment_arrangement.note: There is no online repayment-plan request for Navy Federal loans. Members who are having trouble paying call Member Services at 1-888-842-6328 to discuss options.

help.title: Making loan payments
paragraphs: Pay a Navy Federal loan with a transfer. In the mobile app tap Move Money in the bottom menu, then Start Transfer; in online banking use Transfers. Choose the loan as the To account and the account the money comes from as the From account, enter the Amount, select Continue and pick the Date.

The money can come from a Navy Federal account, and Transfers can also pay off a Navy Federal loan using an account at another financial institution. Review the details and submit to schedule the payment.
Member Services can help with payments around the clock at 1-888-842-6328.
steps: Open Move Money (app) or Transfers (online banking).
Choose the loan as the To account and pick the From account.
Enter the amount and date, then submit.

help.title: Recurring transfers for loan payments
paragraphs: To pay a loan automatically, schedule a transfer to the loan and choose how often it repeats from the frequency menu. You can line recurring transfers up with your paydays.
Credit card automatic payments are also set up from the Move Money tab.
steps: Open Move Money and start a transfer to your loan.
Choose the frequency and first transfer date.

help.title: Switch to paperless statements
paragraphs: In digital banking open Statements (online banking) or Account and Tax Statements (app), then choose Paperless Delivery Preferences and save your choices. You can pick which accounts go paperless.
Up to 36 months of statements are saved online for you to view or print at any time.

help.title: Recover your username or password
paragraphs: On the online banking sign-in screen choose Forgot Username under the username field, or use Recover Username or Password, and follow the prompts to confirm who you are.

You now sign in with your username. Your Access Number is still how you identify yourself on the phone or in a branch, and once you switch to a username you cannot go back to signing in with the Access Number.
A username has 6 to 32 characters with at least one letter and one number, and it cannot include your name, birth date, Social Security number, email address, account numbers or spaces.

help.title: 2-Step Verification
paragraphs: After your username and password, Navy Federal asks for a second step: a security code by text message or email, or a push notification to a device you have remembered.
A texted or emailed code must be entered within 6 minutes. Navy Federal will never call you to ask for a security code.

help.title: Changing your credit card due date
paragraphs: If your card is not past due, you can move its payment due date to any day from the 1st to the 28th of the month. You can do this once every 6 months, and it can take up to 2 billing cycles to take effect.

help.title: Payment history and past statements
paragraphs: Up to 36 months of statements are saved in digital banking for you to view or print at any time. Open Statements to see past statements.
Payments you make online appear in your payment history; a pending payment shows until it posts.
steps: Open your payment history or statements.
Select a statement to view or download.
